note: Every seed replays the same game. The latest profile ate 106 of 107 level-1 pellets by 60 s, then spent 120 s failing to reach the last pellet at (9,2), just above the ghost-house door, so its level-2 red-maze fix never got to play. Cyan and orange never leave the house (the end screens of both runs show them there), but the danger map let them walk out at full speed: every path to that pellet counted as past a ghost (food 66-80), so Pac-Man went back and forth; this probably also slowed v1's level-1 endgame. Now a ghost that has sat inside the house for 20+ decisions counts as 15 steps farther away (one that only just got there, 2 steps) until it reaches the door row, and a ghost blob must be at least 3 cells tall, so thin lines such as the door are never taken for a ghost; the red-wall perception and teacher rules are kept, and new tests pin the level-2 red-maze perception on the saved v1 window.
instructions: heading is Pac-Man's current motion: N=up, S=down, W=left, E=right, stop (stop means there is no heading's action). Each block up/down/left/right describes holding that arrow from Pac-Man's next turning tile. open: 1 = a corridor goes that way, 0 = a wall. room: maze tiles Pac-Man can reach that way at least one step before any coloured ghost (max 30). A ghost that has been waiting inside the ghost house counts as 15 steps farther away (2 steps if it only just got there), because it must first come out through the door. An action with room>=8 is safe; under 8 is a trap. food: steps to the nearest ordinary pellet that way over those tiles, on a path that eats no power pellet; 60 or more means it can only be reached past a ghost; 99 means none. power: steps to the nearest big power pellet that way (60 or more: only past a ghost; 99: none). prey: steps to the nearest blue (edible) ghost that way. ghost: steps from that tile to the nearest dangerous ghost. nearGhost: steps from the nearest dangerous ghost to Pac-Man. blue: number of blue ghosts; flashing=1: they are about to turn dangerous again. Rules, in order (only ever pick an action with open=1): 1) Hunt: among actions with room>=3, if one has prey<=12 (prey<=5 when flashing=1), pick the one with the smallest prey. 2) Otherwise use only the safe actions (room>=8). Power pellets are kept for when they pay off. If blue=0 and a safe action has power<=8, pick the safe action with the smallest power when nearGhost<=7, or when that action is the heading's action and nearGhost<=10. If every safe action has food>=60 and one has power<60, pick the safe action with the smallest power. 3) Otherwise take the safe action with the smallest food (on a tie, the larger ghost). If that smallest food is 99 (no ordinary pellet left), pick the safe action with the smallest power under 99 instead. Keep the heading's action when it is safe and its food is within 0.5 of the smallest. 4) If no action has room>=8: pick the action with the smallest power under 60 if there is one, else the largest room (on a tie, the largest ghost). When visible=0 or over=true, nothing matters.

actions.description: hold the up arrow: Pac-Man goes up at the next tile where up is open
hold the down arrow: Pac-Man goes down at the next tile where down is open
hold the left arrow: Pac-Man goes left (the tunnel row wraps around)
hold the right arrow: Pac-Man goes right (the tunnel row wraps around)

tests.expect: !state.pac || state.heading !== 'stop' || Math.abs(state.pac[0] - 14) > 0.15 || Math.abs(state.pac[1] - 2) > 0.15 || (state.down.open === 0 && state.right.open === 0 && state.up.open === 1 && state.left.open === 1)
tests.why: In level 2 the maze is drawn in red. At (14,2) v1 saw no walls and held 'down' into the wall at (14,3) until a ghost ate Pac-Man. The red walls must be recognised: down (14,3) and right (15,2) are walls, up (14,1) and left (13,2) are corridors.
v1 took the red wall mass (17.6 x 5.6 tiles) for a sprite. Maze-coloured cells of wall tiles must never form blobs, so nothing wall-sized may show up as an unknown object.

In this stretch no ghost is blue: the real red ghost roams and pink roams, while cyan and orange sit in the house. The new sprite-size filter (at least 3 cells tall) must still find the real ghosts in the red maze.
